actor: Server-derived authenticated Joe or Dell. No actor arguments accepted.
generation: watch.id identifies one subscription. Repeated watch preserves its baseline, policy and state. Removed then watched creates a new id and baseline.
concurrency: Every lifecycle mutation requires subscription_id and base_version. Any mismatch refuses watch_stale_version. UUID replay keys bind actor, verb and payload and return the historical receipt.
policy: change_kinds selects reply_arrived, lease_threshold_crossed or listing_status_changed. Lease thresholds require lease_threshold_days, 0 through 3650, or lease_threshold_months, 0 through 120. Each array permits at most 20 unique entries. Month windows use Chicago calendar dates. include_self_changes defaults true.
quiet: Watch, pause, resume, replace and removal never emit notifications. Starting and resuming establish quiet threshold baselines. Scheduled delivery rechecks current policy and visibility.
health: Individual responses add health beside watch, preserving the closed watch object consumed by older v2 parsers. pending_count saturates at 1001 and means at least 1001 at that bound.
pagination: Live UUID pages, at most 100 visible nonremoved subscriptions. No snapshot guarantee across pages.
listing: watch_target_not_found until canonical listing identity and visibility exists.
compatibility: V1 tools and storage remain stable. V1 and v2 delivery share the scheduled receipt consumer. V2 storage is independent; no implicit v1 migration or dual subscription.
